rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person, thing, or style associated with nostalgia.

example.english: The decor of this cha chaan teng is very nostalgic, making me think of when I was little.
example.traditional: 呢間茶記嘅裝修好懷舊，令人諗返起細個嗰陣。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caa4 gei3 ge3 zong1 sau1 hou2 waai4 gau6 ling6 jan4 nam2 faan1 hei2 sai3 go3 go2 zan6

rows.note: Use this when the nostalgic feeling is directed toward a particular past time, place, person, or experience.

example.english: Whenever I return to this beach, I feel nostalgic for the days when I used to fish with my dad.
example.traditional: 每次返到呢個海邊，我都好懷念以前同阿爸釣魚嘅日子。
